news.title: O'Neill students produce guidebook to help Indiana communities reduce energy costs
news.summary_en: O’Neill students created the Indiana Energy Playbook, a practical guide helping communities reduce energy costs and improve sustainability through local action.

news.title: Nonprofits in the Indianapolis economic region recovered slowly after COVID-19 employment losses
news.summary_en: A new report finds Indianapolis-area nonprofits showed resilience after COVID-19, though recovery in employment and services has been slow and uneven.
